title: npmerger — package plan
text: Proposed R package finding, classifying, analyzing nonprofit mergers using IRS 990 e-file data (Schedule N + core 990), built panel990 (retrieval/panels) fiscal (fiscal-health metrics). Background reviewed: Schedule N 2025 form + instructions, 2018 outcomes draft (CEM + design), 2020 IU slides, financial-ratio sources memo, Wilder/MAP Minnesota study (merger = “integration two organizations one legal entity least one ceases exist”, plus transfer programs assets staff), 01-build-merger-panel.rmd (2020 prototype old AWS index).

what: 1. What the experiments found (NCCS efile v3_1, tax years 2019–2021)
title: npmerger — package plan
text: Scripts dev/experiments/ (expect env var S = scratch data directory). Data layout (panel990 tables) Volumes: 3–3.8k Part filings 1.2–1.4k Part II filings per year, 14,399 Schedule N filings 2019–21. 1,004 filings fill parts, even though instructions say . 94 EINs file Schedule N one year. Data-quality issues package handle - Checkbox encodings mixed: 0/1, true/false, NA. - T00 T01 tables don’t line . 1,406 Part filings asset rows, 650 asset rows T00 row. Build filing universe union OBJECTIDs. - 28% recipient rows usable EIN. IRC section free text, around 40 spellings 501(c)(3), plus “LLC”, “INDIVIDUAL”, “GOVERNMENT” others. - FMV negatives implausible outliers (max $11B). Check donor’s beginning--year assets (“coverage” ratio). - 225 transfers go donor’s EIN (reorganizations). - 52% Part filers 990-EZ filers, need EZ summary EZ Part VII tables , just F9 tables. - Recipients: 81% top nonprofit recipients efile. 98% keep filing transfer, 6% formed within year . Prototype classifier (rule-based), validation signals used rules: * Share donor→recipient pairs least one donor Part VII person (t-1..t) appears recipient’s Part VII (t..t+1), matched first + last name. Takeaways: 1. Schedule N lines 2a–2c good merger signal, -reported. 40% “asset transfers” continuing nonprofit box checked still show shared leadership Part VII. Part VII overlap second evidence channel, add roughly 1,000 mergers three years. 2. “Recipient continues operating” nearly always true nonprofit recipients, adds little telling cases apart. useful signals leadership continuity, concentrated transfer (top-recipient FMV share), coverage. 3. mergerN (2+ dissolving donors one recipient year) real: 371 recipient-years. Many system consolidations (hospital systems, chapters folding national office). 132 recipients appear acquirers one year. worth serial_acquirer / affiliate flag. 4. Donor size small transfers closures (median revenue $4k–$10k) larger mergers ($87k merger2 $370k mergerN). Recipients typically 50–100× larger, matches 2020 slides.

title: npmerger — package plan
text: Unit analysis: transaction pair (donor EIN → recipient EIN, Schedule N tax year), grouped merger event. MERGER_ID = YEAR-FROMEIN-TOEIN (9-digit EINs, YEAR = donor’s Schedule N tax year), one per pair. MERGER_GROUP_ID = YEAR-TOEIN links donors folding one recipient (mergerN consolidations). Merger year (t = 0) = donor’s Schedule N tax year. asset distribution date gets mapped onto recipient’s fiscal calendar, recipient’s t = 0 fiscal year contains distribution date. stored. Transaction types returned classify_transactions(), one label per filing, plus evidence columns: Every threshold argument (merger_rules()), output keeps evidence columns (LEADER_SN, LEADER_P7, TOP_SHARE, COVERAGE, N_DONORS, R_NEW, FINAL_RETURN, DONOR_FILES_LATER). Users can re-label without re-running pipeline, run sensitivity analyses strict vs. broad definitions.

Yes, use right layer: - compute_all_panel() gives raw ratios every org-year. _w / _z / _p columns re-estimated within year: percentile z-score relative year’s cross-section. good ranking tracking absolute change time. - fiscal_health_score() fixed fit applies stored centers, scales coefficients without re-estimating. comparable--time index. tested 769 merger orgs (3,142 org-years, 2018–23) scored 2023 calibration, produced index every year. Smoothing. panel990::panel_smooth() centered (odd window, positions t-1, t, t+1). also counts rows rather calendar years, filing gaps get bridged. trailing option, installed version GitHub main. merger panels leaks post-merger information pre-merger years. compared recipients (k = 3), measuring partial correlation t-1 index year-t index, controlling t-2: trailing window cuts noise much centered (−63% volatility), look-ahead.
